summary: The level-set truncation measure is finite, supported compactly in C intersected with the mixed-integer space, and dominated fiberwise by the original mixed-integer measure. The cited centerpoint and mixed-integer Helly theorems apply with h(Z^n x R) = 2^{n+1}; strict separation places the selected point in C, and boundary translation plus measure domination yields the stated constant, including fibers of length exactly 2s.
